description: Terraform / Terragrunt: group providers and modules, except that a minor bump of a 0.x module or provider gets its own PR.

packageRules.description: Group patch updates of Terraform providers and modules

Group minor updates too, but only from 1.0 up. Below 1.0 a minor bump may break the interface, and most Azure Verified Modules are 0.x: avm-res-keyvault-vault 0.13.0 dropped resource_group_name, and because it was grouped with eight compatible module bumps in terraform-root-aks#91, none of them could merge. The negated match on the current constraint (~> 0.12, ~> 0.12.0, = 0.5.0, 0.5.0) leaves a 0.x minor bump ungrouped, so it arrives as its own PR and only that update waits on the fix.
Keep major Terraform updates separate for careful review
